explanation: The UI-change runbook states that Compare links carry their view (/compare[/pathways]?pops=…&genes=…, parsed in appLinks) so a refresh, Back or copied link reopens the same comparison, and that the Compare summary table reads down one row per gene × population. It also records the phone restacking of the gene and pathway result rows, the one-line hub nav and 3 x 2 explorer header, the library starting on cards at phone width, the positioned portal-table-wrap rule, and a check that window.innerWidth equals the device width after load. The explorer breadcrumb now pairs each separator with the crumb after it, so a wrap never strands a slash; on phones the population and tab start a line under the dataset picker without a leading slash.
